The values decrease strictly with \(r\), and every rank \(1\le r\le n\) is realized by a rank-\(r\) endomorphism. The inspected verifier correctly corroborates several fields and ranks.

Applying those two ingredients to \(x=\alpha t+u\) immediately produces the three rank strata and the displayed formula. The absence of an exact phrase match does not make this routine specialization original under the implication-based standard.
